rawText:
120 English For Today
The Bullet Train runs at a maximum speed of 300 km/h (186 m/h). It plans to
increase speed up to 320 km/h (200m/ph). In 2003, Japan set the world
record for unconventional magnetic trainsets. In a test run, the speed was
581 km/h (361 m/ph). But it is not yet in regular commercial operation.
The High-speed Rail
The High-speed Rail service in China started operation on April 18, 2007.
Currently China has started building a high-speed passenger rail network. It
will be similar to French TGV or Japanese Bullet Trains. The usual top speed
of China’s conventional quick trains is 300 km/h (186 m/ph).
Recently, China has set the world record of a speed of 487.3 km/h (303 mph). In
2011, this record was set by an unconventional magnetic trainset called the
“Harmony Express”. This is the highest speed of an unconventional magnetic
trainset in regular commercial operation.
